payload.text: Issue 0650, S: the upgrade that writes the tracked hook dispatchers keeps a marked export-ignore block in the project's .gitattributes, rewritten in place, appended when absent, and written nowhere a line of the project's own already decides; doctor's default root-file-behind line names a .gitattributes that lacks the block and decides nothing; Intent's own .gitattributes takes the block. Bank for vc's stacked judge: refs/bank/ic/0650/fix-v3-on-1fe4a4bec (blob e0e4240e49e0, patch_id 3bad045bdc6d), first of four. fix-v2's run was red at the base and green but for one rustfmt wrap, which v3 is.
